hero.title: UNMADA VARA NYE - The Pulse of Prāṇa
hero.subtitle: The Pulse of Prāṇa
hero.description:
Unmada Vara: The Pulse of Prāṇa

Last time, we stepped into the blessing of madness — into intensity, into letting go. But intensity alone doesn’t sustain. This New Year’s, we move into the next state: Prāṇa, the vital life force. Curated by Temple Twister & HillTop with multi-stage Void Acoustics audio reinforcement.

hero.title: Primal Void
hero.subtitle: 3-Day Sonic Decadence
hero.description: A nocturnal descent into raw hypnotic techno and relentless bass frequencies. Primal Void occupies the iconic open-air amphitheatric cliff of D Pedro, commanding an intimate communion of underground purists, monolithic modular synthesizers, and unbroken hypnotic flow.
hero.venue_address: Baina Beach Clifftop, D Pedro, Vasco Da Gama, Goa 403802

hero.title: Perseverance Festival
hero.subtitle: Winter Solstice Assembly
hero.description: Perseverance embodies endurance through acoustic power. Gathering international audio pioneers for three unforgettable sunsets and sunrises over the river inlet at House of Chapora. Immersive visual arts, artisan markets, high-fidelity sound.

hero.title: Vanaghotra The Decade Ritual
hero.subtitle: 10 Years of Primal Resonance
hero.description: A milestone decade gathering celebrating the raw spirit of Goa trance. Perched directly over the waves with sacred fire ceremonies, experimental visual projection art, and unadulterated high-velocity frequencies.
hero.venue_address: Anjuna Beach, Monteiro Vaddo, Anjuna, Goa 403509

hero.title: Dark Obscura
hero.subtitle: Occult Hypnotic Gathering
hero.description: THE WAIT IS OVER. THE DARKNESS IS COMPLETE. MAGIK BEYOND MUSIC UNLEASHES THE FULL & FINAL LINEUP FOR DARK OBSCURA. Void Acoustics tuned sub-woofers pushing 32Hz pressure, strictly no-flash photography policy, curated for true nocturnal wanderers.
